### Added

- (agent-platform) [Disable organizations where the person may not create agents in the New agent picker](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3508) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — On New agent, the Organization picker greys out organizations where you only use agents, as `Needs the editor role to create agents`, and says so under the picker, instead of failing at the end. Needs an agent-manager that reports the permission.
- (agent-platform) [Turn environments on and off on /profile, with their access health](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3525) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On Profile and settings, every environment is a toggle with its access state: turn one off and the portal shows nothing from it, or use `All on` and `All off`. An expired environment offers `Sign in again`.

### Changed

- (agent-platform) [Mount one persisted query client provider per route](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3531) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — Nothing changes on the pages: Agent Platform pages restore their cached data from the browser's storage once per page instead of once for every section that reads it.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Show a disconnected connector's state in the Tools step instead of 0 tools](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3502) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When creating or editing an agent, a connector that isn't connected shows `Not connected`, `Partly connected` or `Deactivated` in the Tools step instead of 0 tools; the Connectors tab shows — as its tool count.
- (agent-platform) [Say what blocks the toolset and mark connector states in words](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3436) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — In the Tools step of creating or editing an agent, a blocked Continue says what blocks the toolset, connectors name their sign-in state in words, and picking individual tools says what it leaves out.
- (agent-platform) [Hide unavailable deployment details](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3512) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On an agent's page, `Technical details` leaves out deployment information you may not read, instead of showing the backend's permission message; the agent's status stays visible.
- (agent-platform) [Format the remaining session and cache dates with the shared formatters](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3438) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — The Sessions page and the command palette show times in 24-hour format and add the year to older dates. On Model hosting's Model cache, creation dates read as an age, with the full timestamp on hover.
- (agent-platform) [Say when a sign-in from another browser ended the session](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3439) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — When signing in on another device, browser or profile ends your session, the Agent Platform pages say `You signed in somewhere else` and offer `Sign in again`, instead of showing empty lists and zero counts.
- (agent-platform) [Name a model by its display name, else the model it runs](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3472) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On New agent, Edit agent and an agent's page, a model is named by its display name, else the model it runs, the same way everywhere; choices that would look identical also show their configuration's name.
- (agent-platform) [Count cache tokens inside input without guessing the convention](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3451) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Nothing changes on today's installations: the Usage pages and session cost estimates read cached tokens as part of input without guessing the gateway's convention from the totals, which a time window could misread.
- (agent-platform) [Show errors and the current selection in the workspace editor](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3437) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On New workspace and Edit workspace, a save shows which fields need attention, picked repositories come first, unticked ones leave filter selections, keyboard focus stays in place, and technical provider errors fold away.
- (agent-platform) [Say in words when the model provider failed a turn](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3440) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — In a session, a turn the model provider refused, for example over its credentials, gets a heading and a sentence on what happened, instead of `This turn failed` with the gateway's raw error.
- (agent-platform) [Correct model failure recovery advice](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3520) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — In a session, a failed model turn's advice and the notification inbox's label follow the provider's HTTP status, and its technical details open and close from the keyboard without losing focus.
- (agent-platform) [Clarify model failures and stabilize review checks](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3522) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — In a session, a turn the model couldn't answer says `Could not get an answer from the model` and whether to try again or ask the platform team to check its access; the provider's error moves under its details.
- (agent-platform) [Show one progress bar on the Agents tab while Last used waits for its first read](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3513) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On Customize's Agents tab, sorting by `Last used` shows one progress bar while it loads, and the Sort picker keeps one width so the filters no longer move when you pick a longer sort.
- (agent-platform) [Keep a Customize page's environment out of the sessions lists, and add an Environment filter to /sessions](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3515) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Choosing an environment on a Customize page no longer hides other environments' sessions and agents from the side rail, the inbox, the start screen and the Sessions page, which gets an `Environment` filter. Usage keeps its own environment choice.
- (agent-platform) [Complete credential saves and recover stale requests](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3521) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On an organization's page, the credential form no longer shows stale values or warnings after a refresh or a finished request, and adding a model with an existing key closes its dialog.
- (agent-platform) [Disable an organization's changes while it is pending erase](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3533) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — On an organization in `Pending erase`, `Add a member`, `Remove`, `Add model`, `Replace key` and `Replace credential` are disabled, with the notice saying why; `Erase now` stays available.
- (agent-platform) [Name every General Assistant that cannot start sessions on the start screen](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3526) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On the start screen, the alert about General Assistant agents that cannot start sessions counts them, groups them by reason and environment, and links each one; it turns into a warning when one has failed.
- (agent-platform) [Disable an organization's changes while it is erased](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3536) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — While an organization is `Erasing`, its members, models and credentials can't be changed either, as in `Pending erase`, and the disabled fields of `Add a member` now look disabled.
- (agent-platform) [Select a new-session link's agent when its installation name is agent-manager's, and focus its prompt](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3528) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A link in an agent's reply that starts a new session selects the agent it names, or says above the message box why it can't, and puts the cursor at the end of the prepared message.
- (agent-shell) [Remove the dead core-components table scroll rule](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3523) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Nothing changes on the pages: a style rule of the Agent Platform shell that matched no element is gone.
- (auth) [Refuse a Giant Swarm sign-in the catalog cannot match instead of the shared guest](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3453) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — A Giant Swarm employee with no user in the catalog, for example with no GitHub handle in Personio, gets a sign-in error instead of entering as the shared guest user.
- (muster) [Consolidate usage counts and preserve histogram caching](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3511) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — The Connectors usage page and a connector's or tool's Usage tab keep all latency data of a large time window, such as 90 days, instead of a truncated part, and load with fewer queries.
- (muster) [No shared usage cache for guests, and no reused 404 in the settings storage](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3447) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Settings saved in another tab or device can no longer be overwritten by a stale read. For operators: connector usage of guest users is no longer cached.
- (muster) [Show a failed connector's error as a warning on its Tools tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3514) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On the page of a connector that failed to connect, or whose instances all failed, the Tools tab shows why it has no tools as a warning instead of grey text.
- (muster) [Put the connectors' Sign in in a column of its own](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3518) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On Customize's Connectors tab, a connector's `Sign in` button sits beside its `Sign in needed` state, lined up with the other rows' buttons, and long labels wrap instead of being cut off.

### Development and CI/CD

- (agent-platform) [Serve agent-manager from the fixture data set](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3538) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In fixture mode, organizations, models and agents come from the data set. In the portal, an organization's Models, Connectors and Egress tabs and Cost's By model table no longer fail on an item named like a column, such as `default`.
- (agent-platform, gs-common) [Serve workspace-, toolchain- and skill-manager from the fixture data set](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3543) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In fixture mode, workspaces, toolchains and skills show made-up data.
- (agent-platform, gs-common) [Serve kagent from the fixture data set](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3544) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In fixture mode, sessions, conversations and usage show made-up data.
- (agent-platform, gs-common, muster) [Serve model-manager and cluster-manager from the fixture data set](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3545) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In fixture mode, Model hosting's running models, GPU pools and model cache, and its serve, import and pull flows, show made-up data.
- (gs-common, muster, agent-platform) [Fixture data builders and base data set](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3535) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Adds the fixture mode's data builders and its base data set.
- (muster) [Serve muster's reads from the fixture data set](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3537) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In fixture mode, connectors, workflows and connector usage show made-up data in every state.
- (muster, agent-platform, gs) [Fixture mode skeleton](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3529) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Adds a fixture mode for local development, `yarn fixtures start`, that runs the portal against made-up data. Production builds contain none of its code.
- (plans, roadmap) [Keep fixture code out of production builds](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3519) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Production builds no longer contain the fixture code of Plans and Roadmap, and CI fails a build that would.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.39.1...v3.40.0
